name: Spring Rise
description: Making lanterns and admiring lanterns are important ways for people to celebrate festivals in ancient times, and they are also the joyful memories of traditional festivals for countless people. A lantern carries ancient folk culture and people's expectations for a better future. Pinku takes seasons as the theme, integrating the unique scenery, colors and moods of spring, summer, autumn and winter into lanterns to tell stories about the four seasons. No matter the time changes, the four-season lanterns will accompany you through spring, summer, autumn and winter, embracing every good season.
